items.prompt: Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration, wide landscape 3:2, polished painterly editorial style, muted jade teal and warm wood. After an adult language class, three young adult students of similar age standing beside their classroom desks, one introduces a male classmate to a new friend with an open-hand gesture, all casual clothes, notebooks and bags, no teacher at front or authoritative pointing. Friendly natural daylight, clear distinct three people, no legible writing on board or notebooks, no labels, no watermark. Educational setting for correcting a mistaken assumption that a classmate is a teacher; identity is explained by real dialogue, not claimed by appearance.

Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration, wide landscape 3:2, polished soft painterly editorial style, muted jade teal warm cream and wood. Two adult friends preparing to study at a tidy desk. One asks and looks toward a single closed teal book placed DIRECTLY BESIDE a laptop computer; the other points clearly to that book beside the laptop. An open notebook with blank pages and pencil in front of student for writing practice. Computer screen blank, no legible lettering anywhere. Both book and laptop fully visible, no other closed books to confuse the target. No logos, no watermark, calm daylight.

Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration, landscape 3:2, refined painterly editorial art, muted jade and warm wood. Diptych with two equally sized panels, same young adult woman in both. Left panel: finishing work, leaving a modern office carrying a shoulder bag in late afternoon light. Right panel: attending a small adult language class after dark, notebook open, listening attentively to teacher, night sky visible through window. Clear transition from office to evening class, subtle divider. No clocks, no text or numbers on signs, board or paper. Exact 17:00 and 19:00 will be written as real text outside image. No brand, no watermark.
